name: scene-time-node-compat
purpose: Verify the unified GeometryNodeInputSceneTime interface, negative Scale handling, Geometry CPU values with subframes and non-unit frame mapping, round-trip links, and legacy Scene Time migration.
passCriteria: The source test reports SCENE_TIME_NODE_COMPAT_OK after checking Scale=1.0, all four outputs and links, Geometry values for Frame, Seconds, Timeline, and Scaled Frame at a non-unit frame map, and migration of both legacy custom and legacy official Scene Time fixtures.
